title: El Relevo de Ures, MEXITV
comment: relevo-ures (MEXITV): sala principal de una hacienda ganadera en Ures, Sonora. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.GUSTAVO_IBARRA: Mexican man from Sonora, elder son of a cattle rancher, 46 years old, fair sunburned skin, thinning light-brown hair combed back, a thick brown mustache, a black western shirt with pearl snaps, a black leather vest, a large silver belt buckle, dark jeans, black boots, a black felt cowboy hat, his hands empty.
chars.LISARDO_IBARRA: Mexican man from Sonora, younger son who returned after years away, 40 years old, tanned skin, short dark hair with some grey, a short dark stubble, tired but firm eyes, a dusty tan canvas jacket over a plain white t-shirt, worn jeans, scuffed brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.NATIVIDAD_IBARRA: Mexican woman from Sonora, the widowed mother, 70 years old, light-brown skin, white hair in a neat low bun, deep wrinkles, a black mourning dress with long sleeves, a black lace shawl, a small gold cross necklace, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_SALAURES: Main living room of an old cattle hacienda in Ures, Sonora, in the afternoon: thick adobe walls painted white, dark mesquite beams, a big leather armchair at the head of the room, a large framed oil portrait of an old rancher with a white mustache on the wall, a cowhide rug, a wooden side table with a vase of white flowers and a lit candle, dusty golden light from a tall window, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
